prompts.prompt: Edit the provided existing game sprite atlas as a production modular-body sheet for the same game. The input is the EDIT TARGET, not a loose style reference. Preserve the exact 5 columns x 4 rows, twenty separate characters, existing order, cell centers, head sizes, costumes, face expressions, headgear, warm brown outlines and bright flat chibi art style. Preserve front/back orientation exactly as provided (a-front). For each HUMAN or RIDER: remove all handheld weapons, shields, books, flags, bags, torches, bowstrings and both ARMS/HANDS, leaving a clean natural matching-costume torso with shoulders, head and the original tiny feet. Arms and equipment will be animated separately in code. Fill removed overlaps naturally with matching tunic/armor. Preserve quivers on backs as costume but remove handheld bows. Mounted units MUST keep their horses/wolves/elephants and the rider's torso/head, remove only the rider's human arms and handheld weapon. For siege machine cells (crossbow cart, catapult, cannon, oil cart) preserve complete machinery and crew exactly; those are not handheld weapons. Do not redesign, change character identities, enlarge heads, turn front into side or add gestures. Leave generous transparent gutters and full outlines within EVERY cell. Absolutely no text, labels, borders, background, shadows or checkerboard. Genuine alpha transparent background. This is a stripped modular copy of the same characters for sprite rigging, not a new illustration.
